description: Ask ArcSync to clone a GitHub repository and parse its infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, Pulumi, Azure ARM, Serverless Framework) into a diagram. Returns a graphId at once; poll get_parse_status until it completes, then call get_diagram. Uses one parse from the workspace's monthly quota (CDK and Pulumi also use a server-side synth), so call list_diagrams first and reuse a diagram that already exists. Private repositories need the ArcSync GitHub App installed.

branch.description: Defaults to the repository's default branch, or main when ArcSync cannot look it up. Pass it when you know it.

path.description: Subdirectory holding the IaC, when it is not at the repository root.

name: start_parse
title: Diagram a repository
